column2: "Warning! Pressure is dropping because an oxygen storage tank is leaking!"
column6: "Switch to a backup oxygen tank right away!"
column7: "Just wait and hope it stops leaking."

column2: "The Four Bed Molecular Sieve (CO2 removal) broke down. The crew has headaches from bad air!"
column6: "Use lithium hydroxide (LiOH) canisters to absorb the gas."
column7: "Ignore it and keep working with no filters."

column2: "The multifiltration water processor failed. Total reliance on recycling is threatened!"
column6: "Draw emergency drinking water from the survival storage reserve."
column7: "Force the Vapor Compression Distillation (VCD) unit to run past its limits."

column2: "The crew needs more oxygen pumped into the cabin from the high-pressure storage tanks."
column7: "Keep the valves half-closed to save tank safety."

column2: "The Solid Polymer Water Electrolysis machine that splits water to make fresh oxygen is overheating."
column6: "Send extra electrical power to cool down the electrolysis unit!"
column7: "Slow down the oxygen production to save electricity."

column2: "The Sabatier carbon dioxide reduction reactor broke down! If we don't fix it, we will lose the oxygen tied up in exhaled gases."
column6: "Vent the carbon dioxide into space and rely purely on our limited stored oxygen tanks."
column7: "Force the broken reactor to keep running to recycle every drop of oxygen."

column2: We have an empty growing tray. Should we plant lettuce for an earlier harvest or soybeans for a larger harvest later?
column6: Plant lettuce / consequence: A lettuce crop begins growing.

column2: "The space station battery is charging up toward its 15 kWh limit, but the power lines are getting hot!"
"A massive Martian dust storm is heading straight for us! Dust is starting to coat our solar panels."
column6: "Send crew outside immediately to clean the solar panels!"
column7: "Ignore the dust and stay safe inside the habitat."

column2: "Because we didn't clean the dust off, the solar panels are choking!"
column6: "Shut down non-vital habitat systems to save what is left of our 15 kWh power pool."
column7: "Keep all systems running and burn through our emergency battery reserves."

column2: "Mission control warns of an incoming solar flare! Radiation levels are spiking outside our standard radiation shielding."
column6: "Order the crew into the heavily shielded central storm shelter immediately!"
column7: "Ignore the warning and keep working outside to maintain food crop modules."

column2: "The Vapor Compression Distillation (VCD) machine that recycles urine and wastewater is clogged with heavy deposits!"
column6: "Flush the system immediately using extra water and high electrical power to clean it."
column7: "Ignore the clogging and keep running the dirty machine."

column2: "Because we didn't clean the VCD processor, the recycling system completely broke down! Wastewater is piling up"
column6: "Open emergency stored water reserves to keep the base hydrated."
column7: "Force the broken machine to run without repairs, risking total water loss."
